title: The Brain's Night Shift: How Sleep Rebuilds Your Mind
title_zh: 大脑的夜班：睡眠如何重塑你的心智
intro_zh: 本文约930词，配有中文参考译文和4道阅读理解题。

paragraphs.en: Many people regard sleep as a peaceful pause after a long day. In reality, your brain is far from quiet during those hours. While you lie still with your eyes closed, a complex set of operations begins. Your brain performs essential tasks that keep you healthy and mentally sharp. According to the National Sleep Foundation, adults need seven to nine hours of sleep each night. Yet a large number of people regularly get less, thinking that sacrificing sleep is a small price for extra work or study time. However, scientific research has revealed that the hidden costs are far greater than most people imagine.
paragraphs.zh: 许多人把睡眠视为漫长一天后平静的暂停。事实上，在你休息时，你的大脑远非安静。当你闭眼静卧时，一系列复杂的操作开始了。你的大脑执行必要的任务，让你保持健康和精神敏锐。根据国家睡眠基金会的数据，成年人每晚需要七到九小时的睡眠。然而，许多人经常睡眠不足，认为牺牲睡眠是加班或学习的微小代价。然而，科学研究表明，隐性代价远比大多数人想象的要大。

paragraphs.en: One of the most remarkable discoveries in recent years is the brain's 'cleaning system,' known as the glymphatic system. During deep sleep, the space between brain cells expands by about 60 percent, allowing cerebrospinal fluid to flow more freely. This fluid helps eliminate waste products that build up during waking hours. One such waste is beta-amyloid, a protein linked to Alzheimer's disease. Experiments on mice have shown that sleep deprivation dramatically reduces the effectiveness of this cleanup process. Therefore, getting enough sleep is not just about feeling rested; it is a vital housekeeping service for the brain.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来最引人注目的发现之一就是大脑的“清洁系统”，即类淋巴系统。在深度睡眠期间，脑细胞之间的间隙会扩大约60%，使脑脊液更自由地流动。这种液体有助于清除清醒时积累的废物。其中一种废物是β-淀粉样蛋白，一种与阿尔茨海默病有关的蛋白质。对小鼠的实验表明，睡眠剥夺会显著降低这一清理过程的效率。因此，获得充足睡眠不仅仅是为了感觉休息好；这是对大脑至关重要的管家服务。

paragraphs.en: Sleep also plays a central role in memory. During the day, your brain takes in a huge amount of information, but much of it is temporary. During deep sleep, the brain can consolidate important memories, transferring them from the hippocampus to the cortex for long-term storage. This process makes memories stronger and more stable. In one study, participants who napped for 90 minutes after learning a task performed significantly better than those who stayed awake. Thus, a full night's sleep helps you retain what you have learned.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠在记忆中也起着核心作用。白天，你的大脑接收大量信息，但其中大部分是临时的。在深度睡眠期间，大脑能够巩固重要记忆，将它们从海马体转移到大脑皮层进行长期储存。这个过程使记忆更加牢固和稳定。在一项研究中，学习任务后小睡90分钟的参与者比保持清醒的人表现明显更好。因此，一整晚的睡眠有助于你记住所学内容。

paragraphs.en: Sleep also matters for your emotional health. If you have ever felt irritable after a poor night's rest, you have experienced the effect directly. The amygdala, the brain region that processes emotions, becomes overly active when you are sleep-deprived. At the same time, the connection between the amygdala and the prefrontal cortex, which helps control reactions, weakens. This means that without enough sleep, you are more likely to overreact to small annoyances. Regular sleep can regulate your mood and improves your ability to handle stress. In fact, a well-rested person is better equipped to see the positive side of difficult situations.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠对你的情绪健康也很重要。如果你曾经在睡眠不佳后感到烦躁，你就直接体验过这种影响。杏仁核是处理情绪的大脑区域，当你睡眠不足时，它会变得过度活跃。同时，杏仁核与前额叶皮层（帮助控制反应）之间的联系会减弱。这意味着，如果没有足够的睡眠，你更有可能对小烦恼反应过度。规律睡眠可以调节情绪，提高应对压力的能力。事实上，休息好的人更有能力看到困境积极的一面。

paragraphs.en: Sleep can enhance creativity and problem-solving skills. When you sleep, your brain does not simply replay memories; it also reorganizes them in novel ways. This can lead to sudden insights that seem to come out of nowhere. The famous example of the chemist August Kekulé, who dreamed of a snake biting its own tail and then realized the structure of the benzene molecule, is often mentioned. Modern research supports this idea: in a 2009 study, participants who were allowed to dream about a puzzle before a test were more likely to solve it quickly. So the next time you face a difficult problem, remember that a good night's sleep may be part of the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠还能增强创造力和解决问题的能力。睡觉时，你的大脑不仅仅是重放记忆；它还会以新颖的方式重新组织记忆。这可能导致看似突然的洞见。著名的例子是化学家奥古斯特·凯库勒，他梦见一条蛇咬住自己的尾巴，然后意识到苯分子的结构。现代研究支持这一观点：在2009年的一项研究中，被允许在测试前做梦的参与者更有可能快速解决谜题。所以下次你面临难题时，记住一夜好眠可能是解决方案的一部分。

paragraphs.en: For students, sleep is an often ignored but powerful study aid. Cramming all night before an exam may seem like a good plan, but it can actually hurt your performance. When you are tired, your attention drops, your reaction time slows, and your ability to recall information decreases. In contrast, students who maintain a regular sleep schedule tend to have better grades. A study from the University of California found that getting a full night of sleep after learning new material improves recall by 20 to 30 percent. Therefore, instead of cutting sleep to study more, you should treat sleep as a necessary part of your learning strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 对学生来说，睡眠是一个常被忽视但强大的学习工具。考试前通宵临时抱佛脚看起来是个好计划，但实际上可能会损害你的表现。当你疲惫时，注意力下降，反应时间变慢，回忆信息的能力也会降低。相反，保持规律睡眠的学生往往有更好的成绩。加州大学的一项研究发现，在学习新材料后睡一整晚，回忆能力可以提高20%到30%。因此，与其减少睡眠来学习更多，不如把睡眠视为学习策略中必要的一部分。

paragraphs.en: How can you make sure your brain gets the rest it needs? First, keep a consistent schedule: go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Second, make your bedroom comfortable, dark, and quiet. Exposure to bright screens before bed can interfere with melatonin production, a hormone that helps you fall asleep. Third, avoid heavy meals, caffeine, and alcohol within a few hours of bedtime. Regular physical activity during the day can also help you sleep better, but try not to exercise vigorously right before bed. If you find it hard to fall asleep, consider relaxing activities like reading or taking a warm bath.
paragraphs.zh: 你如何确保大脑得到所需的休息？首先，保持一致的作息时间：每天在同一时间上床睡觉和起床，即使是周末。其次，让卧室舒适、黑暗、安静。睡前暴露在明亮的屏幕前会干扰褪黑激素的产生，这是一种帮助你入睡的激素。第三，睡前几小时内避免大餐、咖啡因和酒精。白天规律运动也有助于睡眠，但睡前不要剧烈运动。如果你难以入睡，可以考虑阅读或泡温水澡等放松活动。

paragraphs.en: In summary, sleep is not a luxury or a waste of time. It is a fundamental biological requirement that can restore your mind and body. While you sleep, your brain clears out harmful substances, locks in important memories, balances your emotions, and fuels your creativity. By treating sleep as a priority, you are investing in your mental clarity, personal growth, and long-term health. So tonight, turn off your screens, close your eyes, and let your brain work its nightly magic. You will wake up sharper, happier, and more ready to face the world.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，睡眠不是奢侈品或浪费时间。它是一个基本的生物学需求，能够恢复你的身心。当你睡觉时，大脑会清除有害物质、锁定重要记忆、平衡情绪并激发创造力。把睡眠放在优先位置，就是在投资你的思维清晰度、个人成长和长期健康。所以今晚，关掉屏幕，闭上眼睛，让你的大脑施展它夜间的魔法。醒来时你会更敏锐、更快乐，更准备好面对世界。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: A. To argue that sleep is a waste of time.
B. To explain why sleep is important for the brain.
C. To compare sleep in humans and animals.
D. To give advice on how to fall asleep quickly.
questions.explain: 本题考查主旨。全文从大脑清洁、记忆巩固、情绪调节、创造力等方面说明了睡眠对大脑的重要性，故选B。A与主旨相反；C未涉及动物比较；D只是文中一部分建议，不是主要目的。

questions.q: According to the passage, what does the glymphatic system do?
options: A. It helps the brain produce energy.
B. It expands brain cells during the day.
C. It removes harmful waste from the brain during sleep.
questions.explain: 细节题。第二段明确提到类淋巴系统在深睡时扩大细胞间隙，帮助清除废物，故选C。A、D在文中未提及；B是睡眠时发生，而非白天。

questions.q: Which of the following is TRUE about memory and sleep according to the passage?
options: A. A nap can improve performance on a learned task.
C. The hippocampus stores all memories permanently.
D. REM sleep has no effect on memory.
questions.explain: 推断题。第三段提到“小睡90分钟的参与者表现更好”，因此A正确。B与“巩固记忆”相反；C错误，海马体是临时存储，长期记忆在大脑皮层；D未提及，且REM睡眠对记忆也有作用。

questions.q: The word 'consolidate' in paragraph 3 most likely means?
options: C. To strengthen and make stable
questions.explain: 词汇题。根据上下文“使记忆更强更稳定”可知consolidate意为“巩固”，故选C。A“削弱”、B“推迟”、D“替换”均不符合。
